design: Pre-specified robustness to the annual-accounting Step 1 analysis
accounting_availability: Compustat Quarterly RDQ; records with missing or pre-statement RDQ are excluded
accounting_features: The same named accounting ratios as the baseline; flows use trailing-four-quarter sums and annual growth uses four-quarter lags when fiscal dates are contiguous
outcome: I/B/E/S quarterly-EPS SUE (first announcement strictly after formation, within 180 days)
loss: Gaussian pseudo-log-loss with a common, training-only target scale within each OOS year
low_compute: Ridge regression using current publicly available quarterly accounting data and simple lagged return features
high_compute: Histogram gradient boosting using the Low feature set plus longer lag histories and nonlinear interactions
price_snapshot: Formation-month price, market equity, and same-month return; these appear only in the price-added specifications
primary_moment: S - F, where S = L0 - L1 and F = H0 - H1
